'''Crown of Valheim''' is a post-[[Deep North]] helmet.

==Usage==
When worn, it grants the [[Royalty]] status effect, which prevents non-boss [[creatures]] from attacking the wearer and makes them flee.

It grants -20% stamina usage for attacking, running, swimming and sneaking.

==Availability==
It is crafted at a level 4 [[Black Forge]] with 5 [[Bloodgold]] and a [[Crown Jewel]] dropped by [[Kall Fimbulbringer]], the Deep North boss.

It cannot be upgraded.

'''Crown of Roots''' is an armor piece.

It is sold by [[The Bog Witch]] for 3000 {{Item link|coins}}, after the player defeated a [[Writhan]].

The Crown of Roots gives only 1 armor and has no other known effects, it is mainly a cosmetic piece.
